title: docs(skills): objectstack-api says the form's own publicFormGrant authorizes a public submit and the guest_portal name admits nothing
body:
Fixes #24239
Clause-②: no

## What changes

One published file and one changeset. No behaviour changes; the form routes are untouched.

- `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md`, the public-form passage (lines 87–89 at `8eccf519`, now 87–91). It said the anonymous form endpoints 「run under a synthetic `{ permissions: ['guest_portal'], anonymous: true }` execution context」 and named nothing else, so an author read it as "declare a `guest_portal` set to authorize the submit", or as "the form falls open without one". It now says what runs: the form's own declaration authorizes the submit through a `publicFormGrant` on its target object (create and read-back of its new row, nothing else), decided before any permission set resolves; the `guest_portal` name on the submit context admits nothing and needs no set; a set so named only feeds the grant's result masker. The `enforceAuth` bypass, the Web-to-Lead / Web-to-Case framing, the field allow-list, the `beforeInsert` defaults hook, the walled-posture withholding and the two contract pointers are kept as they were.
- `.changeset/24239-public-form-grant-skill.md` — `@objectstack/skills`: `patch` (the package ships `skills/**` as `dist/skills/**`; measured below).

The three texts now say the same thing, each in its own register: `content/docs/ui/public-data-collection.mdx` (section 2), the `registerFormEndpoints` docstring in `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`, and this skill.

Before:

```
These bypass `enforceAuth`, run under a synthetic
`{ permissions: ['guest_portal'], anonymous: true }` execution context, and
are intended for Web-to-Lead / Web-to-Case style flows. The framework
```

After:

```
These bypass `enforceAuth` (Web-to-Lead / Web-to-Case flows). The form's own
declaration authorizes the submit: a `publicFormGrant` on its target object
(create and read-back of its new row, nothing else), decided before any permission
set resolves. The submit context's `guest_portal` name admits nothing and needs
no set; a set so named only feeds the grant's result masker. The framework
```

## Line budget (`skills/**` readings)

Three lines became five. Nothing else in the file moved, and no line was re-wrapped to pay for them. The widest new line is 82 characters, which is the file's existing maximum for a prose line (line 180).

## Measured

- **(a) The passage is the only place in the catalog that says it.** At `8eccf519`: `grep -rn "guest_portal\|publicFormGrant" skills/` hits once, `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md:88`; the control `grep -rn "enforceAuth" skills/` hits once, line 87 of the same file. No other skill file carries the claim, so nothing else is fixed here.
- **(b) What runs** was not re-measured; the order carries card #24130's measurement. The wording follows `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts` (the `publicFormGrant` branch, about line 2412: it admits `insert` / `find` / `findOne` / `count` on the grant's object only, before any permission set resolves, and resolves the context's named sets only for the result masker) and the `registerFormEndpoints` docstring as `main` has it.
- **(c) `check:skill-docs` regenerated nothing**: the worktree is clean after the run. The generator reads frontmatter; the passage is body text.
- **(d) The file's last `main` touch** is `2c9bf943`, the version script's frontmatter re-stamp; the passage read exactly as the card quoted it at `8eccf519`.
- **The package ships the text.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/skills build` (its `sync-catalog`, self-test 9 cases then the copy): 「65 file(s) across 10 skill(s) copied from skills/** into dist/skills and read back byte-identical」, exit 0; `publicFormGrant` appears once in `packages/skills/dist/skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md`. `@objectstack/skills` declares no `test` or `typecheck` script, so there is no package test to run (a filtered run that matches no script exits 0 and measures nothing, so none is claimed).
- **`origin/main` moved** 3 commits past the base while this was in flight (`fb6fb24e`). None touches `skills/**`, `.changeset/**` or a gate that reads them (the derivation names `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` and one ADR anchor as changed across the range; neither is in this card's derived list), so the branch was not merged forward.

- **42 of 43 exit 0** — among them `check:skills-token-ratchet` (「54 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings」; this file 4691 of 6314), `check:skill-docs` (「Skill docs in sync」), `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:corpus-claim-drift`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:role-word`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:published-files`, and the changeset gates (`check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-empty-changeset`, each with `--base origin/main`; `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`; `check:objectui-changeset`; `check:pm-changeset-deadline-census`). Two of the 42 first refused with `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (exit 3, unbuilt packages): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` and `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure`. After `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/objectql --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint --concurrency=2` under the verify lock (「Tasks: 14 successful, 14 total」; lock 「VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 95s」) both exit 0 (`lean-entry-closure`: 「Admitted set held exactly (15 packages); 6 denied names absent」). `check:dts-closure` and `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` were re-run over the same 15 built packages (「75/75 declared declaration file(s) present」; 「105 map(s), none embed source text」); their whole-tree reading is CI's.
- **1 NOT MEASURED locally:** `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` — exit 3, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`: it loads every package's built output, and 111 packages have no `dist/` in this fresh worktree. A full-tree build is out of proportion for a five-line text change, so this is a declared narrowing: CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it on this PR and is the reading of record.

The two derived-from files that changed across that range (`scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` and `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__rest__src__meta-item-write-routes.ts.json`) belong to families this card's paths do not name — neither is among the 43 commands — so no command above read an old copy of a script CI will run differently.

## Acceptance notes

- The docs page also says which parts of a registered `guest_portal` set the masker reads (its field permissions, and the capabilities it holds against a field's `requiredPermissions`). That clause is not in the skill: it costs a sixth line against a +2 budget, and an author who needs it reads the docs page the passage already sits beside. Noted, not filed.
- The old text named `anonymous: true` on the context; the new text does not. The key has no reader (card #24130's measurement: no non-test property read of `anonymous` in `packages/`), so the skill no longer teaches it. Noted, not filed.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** — 只改一个对外发布的技能文件 `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md` 里讲公开表单(匿名提交)的那一段。原来说这两个端点「在一个合成的 `{ permissions: ['guest_portal'], anonymous: true }` 执行上下文下运行」;现在改为说清楚:提交由表单自己的声明授权——运行时为它派生一个只限该表单目标对象、只允许创建和读回刚建那一行的 `publicFormGrant`,在任何权限集解析之前就决定;上下文里的 `guest_portal` 这个名字不授予任何权限,也不需要声明权限集;就算部署注册了同名权限集,它也只用于结果脱敏。其余内容(字段白名单、`beforeInsert` 默认值、隔离姿态下的下线、契约文件指引)原样保留。另加一条 `@objectstack/skills` 的 patch changeset。

**为什么改** — 文档页和 REST 代码注释(PR #24237)已经改成与运行时一致的说法,技能文件是第三份文本,还在说旧话。AI 作者读技能时会推断「必须声明一个 `guest_portal` 权限集才能让提交通过」(CRM 示例就是这么被误导的),或者反过来以为不声明表单就会「敞开」——两者都不是运行时的真实行为。发布的承诺必须与运行的契约一致。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** — 纯文本改动,不改任何运行时行为。文件 +2 行、+49 token(上限 6314,现 4691),整个技能包 +2 行、+49 token;所有读这个文件的门禁本地均绿(token 棘轮、skill-docs、identifier-liveness、corpus-claim-drift 等)。风险只在措辞是否准确,已逐句对照安全插件源码和 REST 注释。回滚即 revert 这一个 PR。

**席位意见** —

**你要做的** — `skills/**` 是 Tier H 治理面:请读上面的 Before / After 两段,确认措辞与运行时一致;无误则由授权账号 approve,落地由席位经队列完成,不需要你手动合并。
